reranked_evidence.title: Delhi
reranked_evidence.snippet: # Delhi. Megacity and union territory of India. Not to be confused with New Delhi, the capital of India, entirely within the limits of Delhi and New Delhi district. | National Capital Territory of Delhi |. **Delhi**, officially the **National Capital Territory** (**NCT**) **of Delhi**, is a megacity and a union territory of India containing New Delhi, the capital of India. Delhi became a union territory on 1 November 1956 and the NCT in 1995. Delhi's urban agglomeration, which includes the satellite cities Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Gurgaon, Noida, Greater Noida and YEIDA city located in an area known as the National Capital Region "National Capital Region (India)") (NCR), has an estimated population of over 28 million, making it the largest metropolitan area in India and the fourth-largest in the world. New Delhi is jointly administered by the federal government of India and the local government of Delhi, and serves as the capital of the nation as well as the NCT of Delhi.

Explore the incredible history, culture, and beauty of Delhi, India on this unforgettable travel adventure. In this video, we visit some of Delhi’s most famous historical landmarks including the amazing Qutub Minar, one of the tallest brick towers in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Discover the untold history of Delhi as we explore ancient monuments, Mughal architecture, Islamic heritage, busy local streets, and the unique blend of old and new India. From centuries-old ruins and detailed stone carvings to the energy of modern city life, Delhi offers one of the most fascinating travel experiences in the world.

This Delhi travel guide highlights the rich history of the Delhi Sultanate, ancient Islamic architecture, Indian culture, and famous tourist attractions every traveler should see when visiting India. Learn interesting facts about Qutub Minar, Alai Darwaza, and the powerful empires that helped shape India’s capital city.

We also visit the famous India Gate at night, where the city comes alive with local food vendors, families, lights, and an unforgettable atmosphere in the heart of New Delhi.

If you love travel, Indian history, cultural tourism, UNESCO World Heritage Sites, and adventure travel, this video is perfect for you.
